info.title: AGEZT Console API
info.description: The console's HTTP surface, derived from the daemon's operation registry and the console's route catalogue. The console's own endpoints (login, files, voice, rollback, the event feed) are not operation bindings and are not described here.

post.summary: agent_capabilities — POST /api/agents/capabilities (forwards ref, trust_ceiling, tool_allow, tool_deny, noise_policy, config_overrides, memory_scope, workdir, max_cost_mc, max_daily_mc)
agent_repair — POST /api/agents/repair (forwards ref, reason, incident_id, root_incident_id, parent_incident_id)
agent_resolve — POST /api/agents/resolve (forwards ref, resolution, summary, delegate_to, task_type, task_model_chain, incident_id, root_incident_id, parent_incident_id)
agent_task_update — POST /api/agents/task (forwards ref, op, id, task, title, description, scope, status)
agent_wake — POST /api/agents/wake (forwards ref, intent, reason, incident_id, root_incident_id, parent_incident_id)
board_send — POST /api/board/send (forwards from, to, topic, reply_to, text, help)
channel_account_set — POST /api/channel/account/set (forwards kind, label, name, value)
channel_oauth_start — POST /api/channel/oauth/start (forwards kind, label, client_id, client_secret, redirect_uri, instance_url)
configcenter.set — POST /api/configcenter/set (forwards key, value, rating, description, allowed_agents, excluded_agents)

get.summary: data_records — GET /api/data/records (forwards collection, search, sort, desc, limit, offset)

post.summary: memory_add — POST /api/memory/add (forwards content, subject, type, confidence, evidence, half_life_ms)
memory_supersede — POST /api/memory/supersede (forwards old_id, content, subject, type, confidence, evidence, half_life_ms)
provider_connect — POST /api/provider/connect (forwards id, name, npm, api, env, model)
provider_key_add — POST /api/provider/keys/add (forwards provider, env, label, value, active)
research_ask — POST /api/research/ask (forwards question, max_sub_questions, max_sources, verify, max_verify_claims, corr)
run — POST /api/run (forwards intent, model, history, system, agent, execution_profile, auto_approve_caps)

get.summary: runs_list — GET /api/runs (forwards limit, cursor, status, intent, model, min_cost_mc, max_cost_mc)

post.summary: schedule_add — POST /api/schedule/add (forwards intent, model, agent, target, workflow, system_task, tool, payload, interval_sec, at_minutes, days, tz, once_at_unix, window_start, window_end)
schedule_edit — POST /api/schedule/edit (forwards id, intent, model, agent, target, workflow, system_task, tool, payload, interval_sec, at_minutes, days, tz, once_at_unix, window_start, window_end)

get.summary: schedule_fires — GET /api/schedule/fires (forwards limit, cursor, id, status, since_ms, intent)

post.summary: skill_import — POST /api/skill/import (forwards name, description, triggers, body, tools_required, agent)
standing_edit — POST /api/standing/edit (forwards id, name, plan, agent, mode, max_trust, briefing_min, assure, cooldown_sec)

get.summary: tool_log — GET /api/tool_log (forwards limit, cursor, tool, errors)

post.summary: whatsappgw_qr — POST /api/whatsappgw/qr (forwards url, backend, session, key)
whatsappgw_status — POST /api/whatsappgw/status (forwards url, backend, session, key)
workflow_test_node — POST /api/workflows/test_node (forwards workflow, node, data, payload)
world_add — POST /api/world/add (forwards name, kind, aliases, attrs)
